frm3gzk3f2m0k INSERT INTO GLBTMPACBK (TDATE, AC_NO, DRCR, CSH_TRN, PRTCLS, DEBIT, CREDIT, BALANCE, DOC_NO, ACMASTCODE, PASS, POST, CTRNNO, OTRNNO, VOU_NO, VOU_SRNO, OP_ID , SU_ID, RC_COUNT, FD_COUNT, CHQ_PREFIX, CASHIER_ID, CASHIER_OK, CASH_CR, CASH_DR, CSHR_EXCP, DENMTION , REF_ACNO, REF_ACMCD , CHQBOUNCE, FORBRANCH, ATBRANCH, VOU_GRNO , DD_GRNO, GOLD_REC_NO, DD_CLEAR, INTFRDT, INTTODT, AC_TYPE, RECEIPTNO, FD_RC_CNT , SHIFT_NO, PROC_SRNO, AC_CODE, TRNSCNID) SELECT A.TDATE, A.AC_NO, A.DRCR, A.CSH_TRN, A.PRTCLS, A.DEBIT, A.CREDIT, A.BALANCE, A.DOC_NO, A.ACMASTCODE, :"SYS_B_00", A.POST, A.CTRNNO, A.OTRNNO, A.VOU_NO, A.VOU_SRNO, A.OP_ID , A.SU_ID, A.RC_COUNT, A.FD_COUNT, A.CHQ_PREFIX, A.CASHIER_ID, A.CASHIER_OK, A.CASH_CR, A.CASH_DR, A.CSHR_EXCP, A.DENMTION , A.REF_ACNO, A.REF_ACMCD , A.CHQBOUNCE, A.FORBRANCH, A.ATBRANCH, A.VOU_GRNO , A.DD_GRNO, A.GOLD_REC_NO, A.DD_CLEAR, A.INTFRDT, A.INTTODT, A.AC_TYPE, A.RECEIPTNO, A.FD_RC_CNT , A.SHIFT_NO, A.PROC_SRNO, B.AC_CODE, A.TRNSCNID FROM ACBK A, ACMAST B WHERE A.ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE AND A.TDATE = :"SYS_B_01" AND ATBRANCH = :"SYS_B_02" AND NVL(A.CNCLED, :"SYS_B_03") !=:"SYS_B_04" AND A.TRN_TYPE = :"SYS_B_05" AND A.CSH_TRN!= :"SYS_B_06" AND NVL(A.SSD_QUICK, :"SYS_B_07")=:"SYS_B_08" AND NVL(A.SRCOFTRN, :"SYS_B_09") NOT IN (:"SYS_B_10", :"SYS_B_11", :"SYS_B_12") AND A.VOU_GRNO=:"SYS_B_13" ORDER BY VOU_GRNO, OTRNNO
fsvbza53ghyxx INSERT INTO GLBKRD.TMPFRMTRN6 (GMST_CODE, OTHGMST, NRECNO, FORM60_61) SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE AS GMST_CODE, C.GMST_CODE AS OTHGMST, B.NRECNO, C.FRM60_61 FROM GLBKRD.TMPFRMTRN7 A, BANKMAS C , GLBKRD.TMPFRMTRN5 B WHERE :"SYS_B_00"=:"SYS_B_01" AND A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND ( ( ( DECODE(NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_02"), :"SYS_B_03", LTRIM(RTRIM(LPAD(NVL(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO))), TO_CHAR(NVL(C.LINKGMST, C.GMST_CODE))), :"SYS_B_04", :"SYS_B_05"))), LTRIM(RTRIM(LPAD(NVL(TO_CHAR(NVL(C.LINKGMST, C.GMST_CODE)), UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO)))), :"SYS_B_06", :"SYS_B_07"))) ) = LTRIM(RTRIM(A.SRCHGRPID)) ) OR ( UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO))) IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO)))= LTRIM(RTRIM(A.SRCHPANID)) ) ) ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE AS GMST_CODE, C.GMST_CODE AS OTHGMST, B.NRECNO, C.FRM60_61 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE, NVL(B.LINKGMST, B.GMST_CODE) AS SRCHLINKGMST FROM BANKMAS B, GLBKRD.TMPFR MTRN7 A WHERE NVL(B.PANNO(+), :"SYS_B_08") = NVL(A.SRCHPANID, :"SYS_B_09") AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(B.PANNO(+)))) IS NOT NULL AND NVL(B.LINKGMST(+), :"SYS_B_10") !=:"SYS_B_11" AND NVL(B.LINKGMST(+), B.GMST_CODE(+)) != A.GMST_CODE ) A, BANKMAS C , GLBKRD.TMPFRMTRN5 B WHERE :"SYS_B_12"=:"SYS_B_13" AND A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND ( NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_14")= NVL(A.SRCHLINKGMST, :"SYS_B_15") AND NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_16")<>:"SYS_B_17" )

g4a59rzun0m06INSERT INTO GLBSMDN.TMPFDAYSTART2 (AC_TYPE, ACMASTCODE, AC_NO, BAL, BALANCE) SELECT A.AC_TYPE, A.ACMASTCODE, A.AC_NO, SUM(NVL(B.DEBIT, :"SYS_B_0")-NVL(B.CREDIT, :"SYS_B_1")) AS BAL, :"SYS_B_2" AS BALANCE FROM GLBSMDN.TMPFDAYSTART1 A, ACBK B WHERE A.ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE AND A.AC_NO=B.AC_NO AND A.AC_TYPE=:"SYS_B_3" AND B.TDATE<TO_DATE(:"SYS_B_4", :"SYS_B_5") AND NVL(B.POST, :"SYS_B_6")=:"SYS_B_7" AND NVL(B.CNCLED, :"SYS_B_8")<>:"SYS_B_9" GROUP BY A.AC_TYPE, A.ACMASTCODE, A.AC_NO
grytyvbgx6n0k SELECT :"SYS_B_00" SHOWINT, A.TDATE, A.CTRNNO, A.DRCR, A.CSH_TRN, CASE WHEN A.FORBRANCH<>A.ATBRANCH AND A.ATBRANCH IS NOT NULL THEN :"SYS_B_01"||ATBRANCH||:"SYS_B_02"||LTRIM(RTRIM(RPAD(A.PRTCLS, :"SYS_B_03", :"SYS_B_04"))) ELSE RPAD(A.PRTCLS, :"SYS_B_05", :"SYS_B_06") END AS PRTCLS, NVL(A.DOC_NO, :"SYS_B_07")DOC_NO, A.OTRNNO, A.DEBIT, A.CREDIT, SUM(NVL(A.DEBIT, :"SYS_B_08")-NVL(A.CREDIT, :"SYS_B_09")) OVER (ORDER BY A.TDATE, A.POSTSEQNO, A.CTRNNO) AS BALANCE, A.IDEBIT, A.ICREDIT, A.PDEBIT, A.PCREDIT, A.EXPDEBIT, A.EXPCREDIT, A.PASS, TO_DATE(:"SYS_B_10") RENEW_DT, TO_DATE(:"SYS_B_11") INTPSTDT, B.*, :"SYS_B_12" AS E_TRAN_NO, (NVL(A.POSTSEQNO, :"SYS_B_13")) AS POSTSEQNO, C.PROP_NAME, C.PROP_DESIGNATION, :"SYS_B_14" AS PANNO FROM BANKTEMP.TMP78189CSTLEGMST B, BANKTEMP.TMP78189CSTLEGDET A, (SELECT T.ACMASTCODE, T.AC_NO, LIST AGG(T.NAME, :"SYS_B_15") WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GMST_CODE) AS PROP_NAME, LISTAGG(T.DESIGNATION, :"SYS_B_16") WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GMST_CODE) AS PROP_DESIGNATION FROM GLBOZR.TMPFF8LEGPROPDET T GROUP BY ACMASTCODE, AC_NO) C WHERE NVL(A.ACMASTCODE, :"SYS_B_17") = NVL(B.ACMASTCODE(+), :"SYS_B_18") AND NVL(A.AC_NO, :"SYS_B_19") = NVL(B.AC_NO(+), :"SYS_B_20") AND A.ACMASTCODE = C.ACMASTCODE(+) AND A.AC_NO = C.AC_NO(+) ORDER BY A.TDATE, POSTSEQNO, A.CTRNNO
gtch4d148h5ns INSERT INTO GLBTKSL.TMPFDAYSTARTREP1(ACMASTCODE, AC_CODE, AC_NAME, MAC_NAME, AC_NO, GMST_CODE, NAME, MNAME, INST_DATE, AMOUNT, ADDR, MADDR, RTALUKA, MTALUKA, CITY, MCITY, PERIOD, P_UNIT, AC_STRT_DT, OPN_BAL, C_BAL, DEBIT, CREDIT) SELECT ACMASTCODE, AC_CODE, AC_NAME, MAC_NAME, AC_NO, GMST_CODE, NAME, MNAME, INST_DATE, AMOUNT, ADDR, MADDR, RTALUKA, MTALUKA, CITY, MCITY, PERIOD, P_UNIT, AC_STRT_DT, OPN_BAL, C_BAL, DEBIT, CREDIT FROM (SELECT ACMASTCODE, AC_CODE, AC_NAME, MAC_NAME, AC_NO, GMST_CODE, NAME, MNAME, INST_DATE, INST_AMT AS AMOUNT, ADDR, MADDR, RTALUKA, MTALUKA, CITY, MCITY, PERIOD, P_UNIT, AC_STRT_DT, OPN_BAL, C_BAL, DEBIT, CREDIT FROM ( SELECT A.ACMASTCODE, A.AC_CODE, A.AC_NAME, A.MAC_NAME, L.AC_NO, L.GMST_CODE, K.NAME, K.MNAME, L.AC_DUE_DT, NVL(L.INST_AMT, :"SYS_B_00") INST_AMT, B.PEND_INST PEND_AMT, ADD_MONTHS(L.INST_DATE, C.SRNO*NVL(L.INST_PRD, :"SYS_B_01")) AS INST_DATE, K.ADDR, K.MADDR, K.RTALUKA, K.MTALUKA, K.CITY, K.MCITY, L.PERIOD, L.P_UNIT, L.AC_STRT_DT, L.OPN_BAL, L.C_BAL, L.DEBIT, L.CREDIT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY L.ACMASTCODE, L.AC_NO ORDER BY C.SRNO DESC) AS RNO FROM ACMAST A , LNMAS L, LNACCINTMAS B, (SELECT LEVEL AS SRNO FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL<=:"SYS_B_02") C, BANKMAS K WHERE A.SUB_TYPE = :"SYS_B_03" AND A.AC_TYPE = :"SYS_B_04" AND A.ACMASTCODE = L.ACMASTCODE AND L.ACMASTCODE = B.ACMASTCODE AND L.AC_NO = B.AC_NO AND L.GMST_CODE = K.GMST_CODE AND NVL(L.POST, :"SYS_B_05") = :"SYS_B_06" AND NVL(L.CLOSED, :"SYS_B_07") = :"SYS_B_08" AND NVL(B.PEND_INST, :"SYS_B_09") > :"SYS_B_10" AND ADD_MONTHS(L.INST_DATE, C.SRNO*NVL(L.INST_PRD, :"SYS_B_11")) BETWEEN :"SYS_B_12" AND :"SYS_B_13" ) WHERE RNO=:"SYS_B_14" )
